title: Read-only cross-PR record view (ODOC-330): propose lore's command shape and agree provenance/coverage fields with quest-cli
description: "Operator-chosen design, first-party in the opum-doc session (relayed to opum-agent as R-2026-09-29-21, filed here on the orchestrator's dispatch). Binding record read by ref at opum-doc 8b1c331: docs/adr/keep-lore-and-quest-records-on-the-branch-with-a-read-only-view-across-open-prs.md (opum-ai/opum-doc#557, ODOC-330, Accepted 2026-09-29). Records stay ATOMIC WITH THEIR CHANGE'S BRANCH; lore gains the same READ-ONLY view quest gets: origin/dev plus every open-PR head, per-record provenance (ref, owner/repo#N, the SHA read), coverage reported, conflicts shown and never merged. lore sync regenerates a branch's lore:tasks blocks ONLY from that branch; the view never writes. Ships in a pair release. THIS TASK IS THE PROPOSAL, NOT THE BUILD: propose lore's command shape for the ADR back through the orchestrator, and agree the provenance and coverage fields with quest-cli, which is doing the same on its side. Read the ADR by ref before proposing; do not implement until the orchestrator dispatches it."

acceptanceCriteria.text: The proposal (command surface, provenance fields, coverage reporting, and where the read-only view hooks into lore) is sent back through opum-agent for the operator's decision.
The provenance and coverage fields are agreed with quest-cli's proposal (both CLIs read the same records); any divergence is named rather than absorbed.
